description: replace Claude causal lifecycle capture with a Stop-only bounded resolver that uses latest-substantial response selection inside each delegated turn: accept the latest response at or above 35% of the longest response, reject a latest response at or below 15% only when it is at least 600 characters shorter and fall back to the latest substantial response, keep gray-zone captures explicit as capture_ambiguous, and remove SubagentHandback/SubagentStop/TaskOutput/structured async lifecycle hooks and correlation
